description: Source code for a Python script implementing a meta-programming tool called 'pump', which processes source files with specific macros and generates code accordingly. It includes classes and functions for tokenizing, parsing, and executing meta-programming constructs.

classes.name: Cursor
classes.description: Represents a position (line and column) in a text file.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents a token in a Pump source file.

classes.name: CodeNode
classes.description: AST node for a sequence of atomic code elements.

classes.name: VarNode
classes.description: AST node for a variable assignment.

classes.name: RangeNode
classes.description: AST node for a range loop.

classes.name: ForNode
classes.description: AST node for a for loop.

classes.name: ElseNode
classes.description: AST node for an else branch.

classes.name: IfNode
classes.description: AST node for an if statement.

classes.name: RawCodeNode
classes.description: AST node for raw code segments.

classes.name: LiteralDollarNode
classes.description: AST node representing a literal dollar sign.

classes.name: ExpNode
classes.description: AST node for an expression with Python code.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: Environment for variable and range management during code execution.

methods.name: ParseToAST
methods.description: Converts Pump source text into an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST).

methods.name: RunAtomicCode
methods.description: Executes a single atomic code node within an environment, appending output.

methods.name: RunCode
methods.description: Executes a sequence of atomic code nodes within an environment.

methods.name: BeautifyCode
methods.description: Formats code with line wrapping and styling.

methods.name: ConvertFromPumpSource
methods.description: Transforms Pump source code into generated code text.
